entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Macos arm64 crash when running tests after updating to dotnet 9 #119222
  • [Dotnet] DotNet 9 Application Stop to Run with Thread Dead #119221
  • HttpWebRequest.GetRequestStream() still hangs in .net 9.0.8 #119220

Closed

  • [Perf] Linux/x64: System.Threading.Channels Regression on 6/2/2025 6:21:02 PM +00:00 #116490
    10.0.0
  • Cryptography.Tests: No PEM encoded data found #117163
    10.0.0
  • Investigate named mutexes on FreeBSD #10519
  • Consider fully retiring FF-DSA from macOS #118107
    11.0.0
  • SIGSEGV when independent DSA keys are concurrently disposed #71738
    Future
  • Update metadata when entities are deleted by an EnC edit #75154
